modules.name: Personal Letter
modules.source:
%%[ IF NOT EMPTY(@LastName) THEN ]%%

Dear %%=v(@Salutation)=%% %%=v(@LastName)=%%,

%%[ ELSE ]%%

Dear colleague,

%%[ ENDIF ]%%

Add the main personal message here. This format is useful for registration-led congress emails, call-for-science reminders, abstract submission prompts or messages from the congress leadership.

Keep the copy direct and human. The congress examples use this style well when the message needs to feel more personal than a standard news card.

Best regards,

The %%=v(@BrandShortName)=%% Congress Team
